thread:
maria: quick RFC follow-up: proposing a minimal allocator hint surface to reduce fragmentation during staged offload. opt-in and telemetry-first.
liam: show the sketch so we can evaluate interactions with soft_reserve/leases.
maria: sketch: AllocHints { companion_tag, frag_tolerance (0..1), prefer_host_backing, soft_reserve_bytes }. runtime interns companion_tag -> uint32 tag_id stored in slab header; default '__untagged' for callers without hints.
devon: prefer slab-granularity tagging to avoid per-block metadata bloat. good perf profile.
sam: intern IDs on fast path to avoid string compares; keep hot alloc path compact.
anya: fallback fingerprinting can be enabled for experiments, but prod default should be deterministic with no fingerprinting.
liam: rollout plan: enable on canary clusters, collect 48-72h metrics, auto-disable per-tenant if p50 token latency regresses >5%.
maria: telemetry request: companion.host_staging_bytes, companion.vram_bytes, companion.fragmentation_ratio, companion.evictions_per_min.
anya: will add dashboards and alerts (obs ticket created).
devon: policy: do within-tag compaction by default; allow cross-tag compaction only under low load or when fragmentation > threshold.
sam: eviction ranking should consider frag_tolerance so tolerant companions are evicted first.
liam: add config for "mergeable tags" so ops can map multiple logical tags to a single bucket for experiments.
maria: action items: open RFC PR, devon prototype intern table, sam implement fast-path intern, anya add dashboards/alerts, liam author canary SLO rule.
infra-bot: noted: canary flag `allocator.companion_tags.enable` and deployment coordination required.
